frozen_before: CV2 implementation, CV3 calibration and all hill predictions

duplicate_crosschecks: f8 (repeated wake U plus dividing-guide context)

primary.height: physical global y/H, convert yprime=y-yh(x) only for observation mapping
primary.weights: Use fixed CSV weights on visible source points. An unsupported probe prevents a complete-range score; any conditional subset metric must retain the omitted-weight/height coverage and be labelled separately, not substituted silently.
primary.required_reporting: Every station, sign/bias, reverse flow, coverage and worst station; primary target not erased by a pooled mean.

primary.metric: absolute predicted S minus reported scalar at x=0,yprime/H=0.25
primary.reference: Same-surface flat reference at the paper reference station, same physical vertical yprime; not local normal distance or an x-local alternative.

primary.observation: Ground-extrapolated mean U=0 dividing points. Reproduce with the declared CV2 operator; last two tail points linear extrapolation and last-three-point sensitivity where source method is unspecified. Publish wall-shear and finite-probe zero crossings separately.

secondary.metric: weighted RMSE divided by sqrt(sum(w_i*experimental_sigma_i^2)); also give RMSE/Uinf
secondary.notes: Do not count f5 as independent evidence; URANS total model+resolved covariance.

secondary.metric: profile error in S with frozen vertical-height weights
S error at yprime/H=.25 plus full crest profile
secondary.scope: CV7, material coverage scenarios fixed before scores, no unreported mixed-case wake targets

secondary.metric: normalized ratio profile bias and RMSE on yprime/delta
secondary.notes: Use corresponding flat ratios at same vertical height; do not invent bubble Reynolds-stress data.

secondary.height_scale: Experimental numerical delta75 not reported. A shape comparison using paired CFD flat-floor delta75 requires a declared edge criterion (.99Uinf with .95 sensitivity) and thickness reporting; physical-height validation remains conditional.

secondary.metric: dimensionless x-position of Fig9 U=0 is supported; dimensional velocity/rms amplitudes are deferred pending independently justified scale
secondary.notes: Do not infer Uinf by fitting these held-out curves. Preserve source height/extent discrepancies.

secondary.metric: profile error in S at x/H=-2.5 or 2.5 with the frozen vertical-height weights
secondary.notes: Additional validation curves, not duplicates of the Fig6b crest series; do not count derived quantities as independent experimental samples.

quality_policy.legend_occluded: Encoded point retained for provenance, weight zero in fitting and scoring.
quality_policy.duplicates: Repeated source plots/drawing objects do not multiply observations or count as independent experiments.
quality_policy.unsupported_probe: Keep the frozen dataset range; report unavailable/conditional coverage below hm or with unknown height scale, rather than renormalizing away failed locations silently.
quality_policy.parameters: Canonical model constants fixed; calibration uses only flat data; width selected from approach-flow/plateau criteria, never best hill score.

threshold_meaning: Predeclared engineering targets, not software pass gates or statistical confidence statements. Report every model outcome; agreement is not a condition of milestone completion.
